about: Memory Match Chaos power-ups. price null = free for everyone. Each player brings 3 different ones into a Chaos game and can use each once. target: what you pick when using it (none, two = two face-down cards, block = the top-left card of a 2x2 block, row = a row). The rules live in backend/src/memory/rules.rs.

powers.name: Swap
powers.text: Pick 2 face-down cards. They trade places.

powers.name: Peek
powers.text: Pick 2 face-down cards. Only you see them, for 2 seconds.

powers.name: Fog
powers.text: On your rival's next turn their cards show for only a split second and the board blurs.

powers.name: Second Chance
powers.text: This turn, your first miss doesn't end your turn.

powers.name: Mirror
powers.text: On your rival's next turn their board is shown flipped left to right.

powers.name: Lock
powers.text: Pick 2 face-down cards. Your rival can't flip them on their next turn.

powers.name: Rotate
powers.text: Pick a 2x2 block. Its cards turn one step clockwise.

powers.name: X-Ray
powers.text: Pick a row. Only you see its face-down cards, for 1.5 seconds.

powers.name: Scatter
powers.text: Your rival's last pair goes back on the board, face down, hidden in random spots.
